description: Contessa-Nettel于1923年推出的折叠相机。配备Citonar 1:6.3/75mm oder Piccar Achromat 1:11/75mm。快门速度Derval or Pronto with speeds 1/25, 1/50 and 1/100 sec. plus T and B mode。使用4.5×6cm film plates or film packs。

specs.快门: Derval or Pronto with speeds 1/25, 1/50 and 1/100 sec. plus T and B mode
specs.取景器: Sports finder plus reflecting type finder
specs.英文简介: The Contessa-Nettel Nettix is a strut folding plate camera in a leather coated metal body.
